title: Sparkle's Long Roll
markdown:
The little lights in Tomas’s room glowed softly. Tonight his smooth marble, Sparkle, was ready for her very first gentle roll down the ramp. Tomas placed Sparkle at the very top and, with a soft puff of air, helped her begin. But she only rolled a tiny bit before settling down, as if taking a quiet nap.

Tomas’s smile wavered. “Oh, Sparkle,” he whispered. “I wanted you to have a lovely, long roll.” He gave Sparkle a little nudge, but she just wobbled. Sunny, his fluffy spaniel friend, padded over, her tail thump-thump-thumping gently on the rug. Grandpa Lee, his voice a soft hum, smiled from his armchair.

“A little trouble with Sparkle’s rolling?” Grandpa Lee’s voice was as gentle as the moonlight peeking through the window. He reached for a longer, smoother plank and showed Tomas how it could tilt. “Sometimes,” he said, “a longer slide and a little tilt can make all the difference.” He placed Sparkle on the longer plank, then gave it a gentle tilt. Whoosh, Sparkle rolled, and rolled, and rolled, much farther this time. Sunny gave a soft happy sigh.

Tomas’s eyes widened with understanding. “Wow,” he murmured. He carefully fitted the longer plank onto his ramp, making the slide longer and tilted just so. With a very soft push, Sparkle began to roll, gliding like a shimmering streak all the way to the end. Tomas smiled wide, and Sunny wiggled her tail. They tried it again and again, each roll longer and more graceful. Tomas saw how the longer, tilted ramp helped Sparkle glide so beautifully.

Grandpa Lee smiled, eyes twinkling. A gentle tilt helped things roll farther. That was gravity, helping Sparkle race along. Tomas looked at Sparkle, resting peacefully. He looked at the long gentle ramp. A happy sleepy warmth spread through him, like being wrapped in a soft blanket. As the moonlight painted silvery patterns on the floor, Tomas yawned a big wide sleepy yawn. Sparkle lay resting, and soon Tomas would be resting too, dreaming of wonderful rolling races and all the gentle ways the world worked.
characters: Tomas (a quiet marble racer), Sunny (a fluffy rug-thumping spaniel), Lee (a moonlight-gentle grandpa)
